dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple O-shaped and C-shaped structures are visible across the dorsal and lateral regions, featuring high-intensity light-colored perimeters surrounding low-intensity dark centers. The gradient transitions sharply from the dark surrounding pelt into a bright, irregular border, which then fades into a dark interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Concentrated clusters of low-intensity dark blobs serve as the core of most ring structures. In the anterior region, there is a higher density of small, solid, high-intensity white speckles that lack a defined internal gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Three prominent Macro-Annuli on the upper-right dorsal surface form a scalene triangle. A series of smaller ring centroids along the mid-lateral line form an elongated, slightly curved horizontal path.
